Trailer Inspection Forms, Trailer Readiness Forms and the equipment sections of the H2S Safety Supervision Daily Inspection Form are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph — a damaged regulator, a torn mask, a cracked gauge — would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside images, not as text, so this review can confirm that a photograph was taken and when, but not what it shows.

A second limitation applies to today in particular: this review ran at 11:00 PM Central, so the usual follow-up sweep of the next morning's mail for late-arriving 11/04 submissions has not yet been possible. Any form for Wednesday that lands overnight or Thursday morning is not counted here, and some of the coverage gaps listed above may close when it arrives.
